title: AdsAI / Ad Assistant
description: An AI-native Google Ads cockpit: spend, ROAS, ICP fit, campaign priorities, and next-best actions in one workspace.
problem: Ad optimization work was split between reports, intuition, and repeated checks.
system: Budget, ICP, ROAS, alerts, and actions are pulled into one decision loop.
artifact: Live dashboard with campaign priorities and optimization queue.
outcome: Operator sees what to pause, analyze, or optimize without hunting through reports.
